message: I remember the last blackout we had; I felt like a gloriously over-prepared person. As the lights flickered and went out, I confidently reached for my trusty flashlight and power bank, while my husband chuckled at my collection of lanterns. We settled in with our snacks, and I felt a strange sense of satisfaction knowing I was ready for anything. It’s funny how those moments can turn into an unexpected adventure, isn’t it? What’s your favorite way to stay comfy during a power outage?
